Tastk 1: Load and Clean Faculty Salaries Data

faculty <- read_csv("FacultySalaries_1995.csv")
## Rows: 1161 Columns: 17
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr  (3): UnivName, State, Tier
## dbl (14): FedID, AvgFullProfSalary, AvgAssocProfSalary, AvgAssistProfSalary,...
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
glimpse(faculty)
## Rows: 1,161
## Columns: 17
## $ FedID               <dbl> 1061, 1063, 1065, 11462, 1002, 1004, 1008, 1009, 1…
## $ UnivName            <chr> "Alaska Pacific University", "Univ.Alaska-Fairbank…
## $ State               <chr> "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AL", "AL", "AL", "AL", "A…
## $ Tier                <chr> "IIB", "I", "IIA", "IIA", "IIA", "IIA", "IIB", "I"…
## $ AvgFullProfSalary   <dbl> 454, 686, 533, 612, 442, 441, 466, 580, 498, 506, …
## $ AvgAssocProfSalary  <dbl> 382, 560, 494, 507, 369, 385, 394, 437, 379, 412, …
## $ AvgAssistProfSalary <dbl> 362, 432, 329, 414, 310, 310, 351, 374, 322, 359, …
## $ AvgProfSalaryAll    <dbl> 382, 508, 415, 498, 350, 388, 396, 455, 401, 411, …
## $ AvgFullProfComp     <dbl> 567, 914, 716, 825, 530, 542, 558, 692, 655, 607, …
## $ AvgAssocProfComp    <dbl> 485, 753, 663, 681, 444, 473, 476, 527, 501, 508, …
## $ AvgAssistProfComp   <dbl> 471, 572, 442, 557, 376, 383, 427, 451, 404, 445, …
## $ AvgProfCompAll      <dbl> 487, 677, 559, 670, 423, 477, 478, 546, 523, 503, …
## $ NumFullProfs        <dbl> 6, 74, 9, 115, 59, 57, 20, 366, 34, 67, 8, 106, 27…
## $ NumAssocProfs       <dbl> 11, 125, 26, 124, 77, 33, 18, 354, 25, 40, 15, 42,…
## $ NumAssistProfs      <dbl> 9, 118, 20, 101, 102, 35, 30, 301, 27, 66, 19, 66,…
## $ NumInstructors      <dbl> 4, 40, 9, 21, 24, 2, 0, 66, 3, 27, 2, 58, 4, 19, 3…
## $ NumFacultyAll       <dbl> 32, 404, 70, 392, 262, 127, 68, 1109, 89, 200, 44,…
faculty_tidy <- faculty %>%
  select(State, Tier,
         AvgFullProfSalary,
         AvgAssocProfSalary,
         AvgAssistProfSalary) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("Avg"),
    names_to = "Rank",
    values_to = "Salary"
  )

faculty_tidy <- faculty_tidy %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = case_when(
      Rank == "AvgFullProfSalary" ~ "Full",
      Rank == "AvgAssocProfSalary" ~ "Assoc",
      Rank == "AvgAssistProfSalary" ~ "Assist"
    )
  )

glimpse(faculty_tidy)
## Rows: 3,483
## Columns: 4
## $ State  <chr> "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK", "AK…
## $ Tier   <chr> "IIB", "IIB", "IIB", "I", "I", "I", "IIA", "IIA", "IIA", "IIA",…
## $ Rank   <chr> "Full", "Assoc", "Assist", "Full", "Assoc", "Assist", "Full", "…
## $ Salary <dbl> 454, 382, 362, 686, 560, 432, 533, 494, 329, 612, 507, 414, 442…
faculty_tidy <- faculty_tidy %>%
  mutate(Rank = factor(Rank, levels = c("Assist", "Assoc", "Full")))

ggplot(faculty_tidy, aes(x = Rank, y = Salary, fill = Rank)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Tier) +
  theme_minimal()

chemicals <- c(
  "alpha-pinene","para-cymene","alpha-terpineol","cedr-9-ene",
  "alpha-cedrene","beta-cedrene","cis-thujopsene","alpha-himachalene",
  "beta-chamigrene","cuparene","compound 1","alpha-chamigrene",
  "widdrol","cedrol","beta-acorenol","alpha-acorenol",
  "gamma-eudesmol","beta-eudesmol","alpha-eudesmol",
  "cedr-8-en-13-ol","cedr-8-en-15-ol","compound 2","thujopsenal"
)

juniper_tidy <- juniper %>%
  select(YearsSinceBurn, all_of(chemicals)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -YearsSinceBurn,
    names_to = "ChemicalID",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  )

glimpse(juniper_tidy)

Task 5:

library(broom)

model_results <- juniper_tidy %>%
  group_by(ChemicalID) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(Concentration ~ YearsSinceBurn, data = .)))

significant_results <- model_results %>%
  filter(term == "YearsSinceBurn", p.value < 0.05)

significant_results
